problem_type: Support entrypoints retain retired module ownership
symptom: Unpaid director evaluation cannot start; converter imports deleted layout/navigation/tables; lab:onboard targets a deleted engine.
direct_cause: Duplicated barrel and undeleted consumers outlived removal of their authoritative modules.
class_root: Support entrypoints did not converge on current public owners when their implementation was retired.
internal_only_reason: Current repository public design exports and MCP onboarding are the authoritative owners; no external API is changed.
invariants: Current support entrypoints import existing canonical modules.
Removed onboarding engine is not restored as a parallel path.
Synthetic-oracle is nonempty and never uses real inference.

door_reduction.why_not: Design preview host and director card loading serve independent current support paths; only their stale dependencies are removed.

generality_proof: Canonical public design exports replace copied module lists; obsolete flag and deleted onboarding engine cables are removed rather than given fallback implementations.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Existing canonical standalone preview provider; converter entry re-exports this definition instead of copied modules.
Run current director lane without a retired feature flag.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Real esbuild bundle must resolve the canonical public API.
One actual oracle card traverses the current lane and local HTTP tool fixture.

recurrence.reason: Copied ownership and undeleted callers fail across every subsequent support invocation.
same_class_scan: Inspected release-writer fixture injection and private DS converter setup

prevention.invariant: Support entry modules import current canonical owners; retired native-eval/DS/onboarding dependencies have no callable advertised cable.
prevention.failure_mode: Bundling/import errors stay visible; no generated fallback or fake engine.
prevention.strategy: Remove obsolete startup imports at the existing director entry, re-export the existing public design API/provider at the converter entry, and delete retired onboarding callers. Canonical provider implementation remains unchanged.

legacy_paths.rationale: Only obsolete consumers of already removed engines/flags are retired.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Reuses installed esbuild and current director lane; private DS setup is a separate documented prerequisite.

migration: No user project, catalog, credential, media or installed app migration.
residual_risks: Private design converter .ds-sync setup remains optional; bundling does not install it or certify external converter publishing.
